correctness.rationale: Partial transpose on the first qubit of the explicit 8x8 density operator factors into two zero eigenvalues, 2eta/3, (1-eta)/2, [3(1-eta) +/- sqrt(41eta^2-18eta+9)]/12 and [eta +/- sqrt(eta^2+9(1-eta)^2 s^2)]/6. Independently constructed symbolic partial transpose and exactly factored the characteristic polynomial into these four factors (2 zeros). First minus root is negative precisely eta>0, second minus root negative when s>0 and eta<1, giving stated negativity. Derivative 3(1-eta)^2 s/(2 sqrt(eta^2+9(1-eta)^2s^2)) positive away from endpoints. eta=0,1 and s=0 correctly handled; all three cuts identical by permutation symmetry.
